faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.sub: The short version of everything people ask us.
faq.a1: Toone is a native macOS workspace for projects that use AI agents: specialised agents, the repeatable routines they run, and the tools and knowledge they share, kept together in one place.
faq.a2: Anyone on a Mac with complex, multi-step work that comes back every week or month: operators, researchers, marketers, founders and creators. You bring your own Claude Code or Codex, turn the work into a routine, and watch, pause, edit and review each run.
faq.q3: Do I need an existing subscription?
faq.a3: Yes. Toone works with your own OpenAI or Anthropic subscription and connects to it during setup. There is no separate model plan to buy from us.
faq.a4: A small one. You describe agents and routines in natural language, and the guided setup takes you from install to a first routine run in about fifteen minutes. The Explore page also has reviewed routines and bundles you can open in Toone and adapt.
faq.a5: Toone runs on your Mac. Your provider credentials and project files stay with you, every run is visible while it happens, and routines can pause for your approval before sensitive steps. Routines and bundles shared in Explore are reviewed before they are listed.
faq.a6: Create an account on trytoone.com, choose a plan, and download Toone for your Mac. If you have a code, redeem it at trytoone.com/redeem.
faq.q7: Can I keep using my existing app?
faq.a7: Yes. Existing account holders can continue signing in with their usual method.
faq.a8: Redeem your personal code on the website to create an email and password account, then use it in the desktop app.
faq.q9: Is Toone free? What does Toone Pro add?
faq.a9: Yes. Every account can create {free} routines for free, and running routines is never limited. Toone Pro removes the limit on creating routines, with a monthly, a yearly or a single lifetime payment. Plans and prices are on the pricing page.

explore.aboutWhat: Explore is Toone's public library of routine and workflow templates. People share routines they already run in their own work, across professions and use cases, so you can start from a process that works instead of an empty page. A routine is one repeatable job, and a bundle groups routines that belong together. Each listing explains the outcome, who it is for, how the work is broken down and what it needs from you before it runs.
explore.aboutReview: Toone reviews every listing before it appears here. Shared copies have personal details removed and are checked for secrets, private data and unsafe instructions. Listings are free to use, and adding one to your organization never overwrites your existing agents, Skills or routines.
